28:t_005:3.en:
???
「When that happens, leave it to us!」

28:t_006:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ワッ太$$! And $$正太郎$$ too!」

28:t_006:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's so mean! You left us behind again!」

28:t_006:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We're fighting in Tokyo this time, so you can't get away with telling us to protect Japan!」

28:t_006:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$ told me. You made us stay behind because you were worried about us, $n.」

28:t_006:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've been ready to fight for ages, no matter who we're up against!」

28:t_006:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We have things we need to protect too!」

28:t_006:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「And we're not the only ones who feel that way.」

28:t_007:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「The EVAs...! Is that $$シンジ$$ and the others!?」

28:t_007:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry we're late...! $$綾波$$ and I will fight too!」

28:t_007:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You convinced that dad of yours...!?」

28:t_007:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It took a while, but in the end he told me to do as I pleased and let us sortie.」

28:t_007:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They're not as childish as you think they are.」

28:t_007:8.en:
$$マオ$$
「Besides, you're ten years too young to be kids worrying about other kids.」

28:t_007:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone... I know you feel responsible, but don't rush yourselves.」

28:t_007:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「To me, you and $$ワッ太$$'s group are all people I need to protect.」

28:t_007:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. To me and Miss $$スズネ$$, you're just $$ワッ太$$ with a few hairs sprouting.」

28:t_007:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, well... I wonder how the Volunteer Club's lovely teacher interpreted that...」

28:t_007:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Uh... I didn't mean it that way...!」

28:t_007:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Wh-what? Now you're all joining in...!」

28:t_007:21.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What does she mean, $$キャシー$$?」

28:t_007:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, stop trying to hide your laughter!」

28:t_007:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「E-everyone...! We're in the middle of a battle!」

28:t_007:26.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But the pressure hanging over the unit has vanished.」

28:t_007:27.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All right, you brats! The enemy's waiting!」

28:t_008:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's go, $$宗介$$! If you don't like being protected, show us what you can do!」

28:t_008:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is not about protecting or being protected. We are comrades.」

28:t_008:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Now you're talking! Let's hit 'em together!」

28:t_009:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'll teach that big brute a lesson! You boys ready!?」

28:t_010:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How's that, big guy!? With us pounding you this hard, you don't have time to put up that precious barrier!」

28:t_011:0.en:
$n
「It's using the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ to hold its body together!」

28:t_012:1.en:
$$アル$$
「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ operation normal. That was not a bad attack.」

28:t_012:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Judging by that roundabout wording, there really is something wrong with your brain.」

28:t_012:3.en:
$$アル$$
「I will praise you once the enemy is annihilated. Or do you intend to make the amateur's mistake of assuming victory with enemies remaining?」

28:t_012:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up. I'll finish off the rest, just as you wish.」

28:t_013:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「They're amazing... $$マオ$$, $$クルツ$$, and $$宗介$$...」

28:t_013:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We can't let them outdo us!」

28:t_013:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we don't pull our weight here, there was no point in coming!」

28:t_013:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The enemy's morale is falling now that we've crushed their trump-card reinforcements! Press the attack and overwhelm them!」

28:t_014:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「We managed to win somehow...」

28:t_014:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ and his team are pursuing the enemy soldiers who escaped.」

28:t_014:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Today's attack was only a probe, so I doubt they sent anyone important...」

28:t_014:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But we did gain something.」

28:t_014:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Indeed. I feel a little more at ease now.」

28:t_015:0.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$ワッ太$$. You too, $$正太郎$$, $$オックス$$, $$シンジ$$, and $$レイ#pt394$$.」

28:t_015:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then treat us to Galaxy Ramen too, not just Trident-yaki.」

28:t_015:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry, $n. ...$$ワッ太$$ and the others saved all of us today... Basically, we've still got a long way to go.」

28:t_015:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「There you have it, $$マオ$$. We kids will let the adults look after us, like kids should.」
